{{Quote|The Zarracines refused to accommodate Coruscant's envoys and on the verge of capture the entire ruling council killed themselves to avoid conversion and spite their conquerors.|Doctor Gabrel Treon, "Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes"|<ref name="Tinker">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/praji/20090205.html|text=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji|int=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji}}</ref>}}
The [[Zarracine]]s, the native [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zarracina III]], were governed by a '''ruling council'''. In [[11,660 BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], which was under the control of the [[Speciesism|speciesist]] [[Pius Dea]] cult at the [[Time/Legends|time]], attempted to capture Zarracina III. To avoid being converted to the Pius Dea religion and to spite the Republic, the entire ruling council committed [[Death/Legends|suicide]].<ref name="Tinker" />
